artifacts.summary: Six phases, 6 hours: promote the compiled no-pending-forever prototype to a wired evidence probe; file the counter-lift lemma as a gated research-first successor task and declare the 761 edge plus 761's dated amendment; record the presentation decision (set-valued datum D over Q x ClType x K, no tuple index, K a carrier coordinate) in ROADMAP, the RaySummary README and the source-store guidance note; full gate set and summary.

memory_candidates.content: Design-decision tasks in the RaySummary decidability programme decompose into a stable four-part shape: (1) promote any research-round prototype under specs/{task}/prototype/ to specs/evidence/ via git mv plus a header rewrite, #print axioms lines, one decision row and one WIRED entry in scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh; (2) file the named open problem as its own research-first, gated task through state-write.sh and declare the dependency edge on the blocked parent with update-task-status.sh --depends-on-add (status-no-op replay of the parent's current status), amending the parent's description and records/*-amendment.txt; (3) sync three records in their own registers -- specs/ROADMAP.md (batch ordering, enumerated regions, kept-sentence counts), the RaySummary README '(W)' narrative (name probes by path, never ordinal: the narrative stops at the fifteenth probe), and the lean extension's source-store guidance note (edit the working tree at source_dir, additive, never the deployed mirror; it already carries an uncommitted prior-round edit); (4) the full gate set. A refuted tuple shape may legitimately reappear as a carrier coordinate of a set-valued datum when the datum factors the cells and the tuple's parameters are lemma outputs -- record that distinction explicitly or the shape gets re-filed as an index candidate.
